rules.statement: A lease for any period exceeding one month must be notarially attested to be of force or avail in law, and a contract which is of no force or avail in law is void.
rules.supporting_quote: "No document affecting immovable property, unless notarially attested, other than a lease at will, or for any period not exceeding one month, shall be of force or avail in law."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance, No. 7 of 1840 (Cap. 57)
